gate.note: passed on first run; no re-curation loop was triggered

final.note: same mask as the gate, so this measures assembly fidelity rather than generalisation; prediction was blind but grading was performed by the assembling agent

projection.sampling_note: Class-stratified, so cluster coverage is uneven: c01/c03/c04 carry 6 items each while c05, c09, c10 and the secondhand Harbaugh cluster carry none. Well covered on public advocacy, the Autobiography and the Presidency; untested on the Rough Riders narrative, the 1877-1886 diaries and Winning of the West vols. II-III. Honest expectation for the untested domains is lower than the reported score.

cost.note: core carries 13 cost-refusals and 7 interactional elements; 9 refusals and 4 interactional moves are stated in SKILL.md itself, the rest in references/

style.modulation_note: contestation lengthens rather than clips: corpus +23.7% (c01 38.79 vs 31.36 words), samples +23.7% (30.62 vs 24.76)
style.notes: Shape and modulation hold. Two real divergences: R1 sample sentences run 10-17% short of baseline, and booster rate overshoots baseline by 2.1-3.7x. Booster rates over 400-900 word samples are noisy against a 379,950-word baseline, so the ratio is more reliable than its magnitude.

R2.note: no R2 sample generated; the third-person narrative family is untested by style-match

discrimination.note: the one confusion pair is the same work in the same family and is merged into a single module in the shipped package

name_audit.note: nine of sixteen names are attested fewer than five times; Roosevelt's coinages are rare in his own writing. malefactors of great wealth and New Nationalism have zero attestation and are excluded from the package.
